headline: AI-Powered Landing Page Designer: Create Stunning
short_description: This skill enables users to create visually stunning and interactive landing pages using the Gemini 3 model and AI-enhanced design tools. By leveraging screenshots, design templates, and AI prompts, users can efficiently generate high-quality, customized websites for personal use or client projects.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The AI-Powered Landing Page Designer skill enables users to craft visually stunning and interactive landing pages effortlessly. Utilizing the Gemini 3 model and AI-enhanced design tools, this Claude Code skill allows for the generation of high-quality, customized websites tailored to personal or client needs. By integrating screenshots, design templates, and AI prompts, users can create engaging web experiences in a fraction of the time it would typically require. One of the key benefits of this skill is its ability to save time. With an implementation time of just 30 minutes, developers, product managers, and AI practitioners can quickly produce professional-grade landing pages without extensive design expertise. This efficiency is particularly valuable in fast-paced environments where rapid deployment of marketing materials is crucial. The skill is designed to streamline the workflow, allowing users to focus on strategy and content rather than getting bogged down in design details. This skill is ideal for individuals in roles such as web developers, marketing professionals, and product managers who are looking to enhance their online presence or deliver projects for clients. It is particularly useful for AI agencies that require visually impressive landing pages to showcase their services. Use cases include designing customized business websites in minutes, developing advanced interactive features for SaaS product pages, and creating promotional landing pages for marketing campaigns. With a beginner difficulty level, this skill is accessible to anyone interested in leveraging AI for web design. No advanced technical knowledge is required, making it a perfect entry point for those new to AI automation. By integrating this skill into AI-first workflows, users can enhance productivity and creativity, enabling them to produce high-quality web assets that stand out in a competitive digital landscape.
Design and build visually impressive landing pages for AI agencies
Create customized business websites using AI within minutes
Develop advanced interactive features for SaaS product pages
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
Create a landing page for my [BUSINESS_TYPE], called [BUSINESS_NAME]. This page should [DESCRIBE_PRIMARY_FEATURE]. Use the style of [REFERENCE_WEBSITE], applying [COLOR_SCHEME] with [STYLE_INSTRUCTIONS] such as [SPECIFIC_ANIMATION]. Include a hero section with [HERO_SPECIFICATIONS]. Use this image as inspiration: [IMAGE_LINK].
```
Copy

```
Create a landing page for my AI Consulting Agency, called Future Insights. This page should highlight our lead generation capabilities. Use the style of linear.app, applying a blue and white color scheme with modern, sleek animations like fade-in effects. Include a hero section with a catchy headline, a brief description of our services, and a call-to-action button. Use this image as inspiration: https://example.com/sample-image.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
